necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and a history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. This specific diagnostic procedure is required to evaluate the patient's condition given the diagnosis codes R55, I25.10, and I48.91.
